vorlage.einsteiger.name: Beginner
vorlage.einsteiger.text: Only the essentials for setting up and backing up: packages, users, encryption, backup, bin, email and address, region and system status.
vorlage.haushalt.name: Household
vorlage.haushalt.text: For a household that sets up more itself: adds folder types, views, automations, stamps, post and intake, search and full text, full export, languages, To dos, sign-in protection, log, reported errors and maintenance.
vorlage.selbstaendig.name: Self-employed
vorlage.selbstaendig.text: For the self-employed and landlords: adds number sequences, retention expired and data protection.
vorlage.organisation.name: Business
vorlage.organisation.text: For businesses with several people: adds themes.
vorlage.alles.name: Everything
vorlage.alles.text: Every area of the Workbench, including the database connection and data for measurements.
meine.text: Applies only to you. Without your own choice you see the template for everyone; what is hidden or shown for everyone applies here too.
